aj_abrir_con_escena: Open the board with the scene
aj_abrir_con_escena_ayuda: Opening a scene opens the board it had.
aj_activas_ayuda: A turned-off tool does not load: no submenu and no shelf icon.
aj_aprendizaje_ayuda: Hovering a button shows a card explaining what it does.
aj_biblioteca_ayuda: Where Árboles keeps your trees, thumbnails and own materials.
aj_carpeta_complemento_ayuda: Where Painter looks for its Python plugins. Change it only if your Documents folder lives elsewhere (OneDrive, network…). In Painter: Python → Plugins Folder.
aj_copia_activada: Copy each version to another folder
aj_copia_carpeta_ayuda: A USB drive or a cloud folder.
aj_estante_ayuda: If you deleted the MantiTools shelf or it is missing icons, this rebuilds it.
aj_idioma_ayuda: Changes the language of all tools at once. Tools not yet translated stay in Spanish.
aj_lm_modo_ayuda: «From the scene» suggests Scene when there are zones, portals, a sun or many practical lights. Each scene remembers the last mode used.
aj_lm_norte_ayuda: Degrees to rotate the scene so its north faces −Z.
aj_lm_ver_arnold: Show Arnold values in the light card
aj_materials_nota: Materials also has these settings in its own Settings tab. They apply when its window is reopened.
aj_miniaturas: Save a thumbnail with each version
aj_pausa_reproduccion: Don't save while playing back or rendering
aj_plantilla_ayuda: For example {escena} or {asignatura}_{apellido}_{escena}. The version is added automatically.
aj_radial_vivo_ayuda: Radial keeps its own window to adjust size while seeing the menu.
aj_rd_nivel_ayuda: Level the Quality tab opens with. All three change the same values.
aj_rd_nucleos_ayuda: Leaving two cores free keeps Maya responsive while it renders.
aj_render_automatico: Switch grass to render quality when rendering
aj_render_automatico_ayuda: Applies to new scenes and to layers you create from now on.
aj_ruta_painter_ayuda: Empty: searched for in the applications folder.
aj_sincronizar: Reload textures when exporting from Painter
aj_trepadora_res_ayuda: Used by new plants and by export.
aj_ventana_ms_ayuda: How long the second Tab can take. Raise it if the menu is hard to open.
aviso_clase: MantiTools: the class folder has a problem: {error}
aviso_clase_herramienta: MantiTools: could not apply class settings for {herramienta}: {error}
aviso_desactivada: {herramienta} is turned off. Turn it on in MantiTools › Settings.
aviso_menu: MantiTools: could not create the {herramienta} menu: {error}
ayuda_paso_1: Pick a tool on the «MantiTools» shelf.
ayuda_paso_2: Left click opens its window; right click, its quick commands.
ayuda_paso_3: Everything you can configure is in the Settings tab.
ayuda_problemas_texto: Check the installation and copy the report to paste it into an email to your teacher.
bloqueada_ayuda: Set by the teacher in the class folder.
clase_no_existe: I can't find that folder. Is the classroom drive connected?
clase_resumen: Class folder read: {fijadas} settings set by the teacher and {desactivadas} tools turned off.
clase_sin: If your teacher gives you a class folder, put it here. Inside, each tool looks for its subfolder (radial/, materials/) and a mantitools_clase.json with what the teacher sets for the group.
complemento_copiado: Plugin copied to {ruta}. In Painter, tick it in the Python menu.
complemento_instalado: ✓ The plugin is in that folder. In Painter, tick it in the Python menu (materials_painter).
complemento_no_instalado: The plugin is not in that folder: press «Copy the plugin there».
comprobar_avisos: There are warnings: see the lines starting with «!».
desc_arboles: Modular tree editor and a library to plant a garden.
desc_grasseditor: Layered grass with brush, types and performance control.
desc_lightmanager: Arnold lights in stops and Kelvin: studio schemes, interiors and exteriors with zones, sun by time of day and checks.
desc_materials: OpenPBR material library with a round trip to Substance Painter.
desc_muro: Reference and notes board inside Maya, with a ghost over the viewport.
desc_radial: Radial or pill menu on double Tab, configurable, with a command search.
desc_renderdesk: Arnold render panel next to the viewer: stackable presets, test history with A/B and background final render.
desc_simplesave: Versions with note and thumbnail, configurable autosave and recovery.
desc_trepadora: Ivy and climbers that grow over any mesh, with instanced leaves.
desinstalado_sueltas: The tools you had installed separately are active again.
desinstalado_texto: MantiTools uninstalled. Restart Maya to finish. Removed {mod} and the shelf.
guia_no_hay: I can't find that tool's guide.
idioma_cambiado: Language changed. Open windows pick it up when reopened.
informe_maya_aviso: MantiTools is meant for Maya 2026 and 2027.
informe_no_incluida: the pack doesn't include it (its folder is missing from «incluidas»)
informe_otra_copia: another copy is in use ({ruta}), not the pack's
informe_suelta: {herramienta} is also installed separately ({ruta}). Drag instalar.py again to set it aside.
instalado_painter: I also copied Materials' Substance 3D Painter plugin.
instalado_sueltas: You had these installed separately: {herramientas}. I set them aside (not deleted) so they don't load twice; your settings still apply.
instalado_texto: MantiTools is installed. You have the MantiTools menu at the top and the MantiTools shelf with one icon per tool.
menu_openpbr_ayuda: For scenes made with earlier versions: switches Trepadora and Árboles materials to openPBRSurface. Textures stay the same.
openpbr_nada: There were no old materials to convert: the scene already uses OpenPBR.
pagina_inactiva: This tool is turned off. Turn it on in General to see its settings.
pagina_sin_cargar: This tool has not loaded. See Help › Check installation.
reinstalar_pregunta: MantiTools is already installed. What do you want to do?
tarjeta_desactivada: Turned off. Turn it on to use it.
tarjeta_fallo: Could not load. See Help › Check installation.
tarjeta_profesor: Turned off by the teacher (class folder).
